svg.title: Tiles that move by themselves
svg.desc: One channel of a layout's tile animation. Several pictures of the same patch of the map are stored apart from the tiles on screen. The channel copies the first over the patch's tiles, waits a few frames, copies the second, waits, and so on, then goes back to the first. Nothing else changes: every cell that uses those tiles shows the new picture at once. On screen, Vale's waterfall and river as the game plays them, several channels changing their tiles at once. A layout can run up to 16 channels, each on its own timer.
